function.description: Type text into the element that has the focus (click it first). Use it for an editor or a widget that browser_input_text cannot fill. A line break makes a new line. submit=true presses Enter after.
function.name: browser_type_text

parameters.description: Model for typing text into the element that has the focus.

submit.description: true = press Enter after the text

text.description: The text; a line break becomes a new line, not a submit
